name: site-reliability
title: Observability, incidents and reliability
summary: Know what production is doing and keep it up: logs, errors, metrics and traces, dashboards and alerts, SLOs, incident response, postmortems and runbooks, capacity and scaling, and disaster recovery.
useWhen: Set up logging, error tracking and monitoring for this app
Production is down or erroring right now; help me handle it
We get too many alerts, or we found out about the outage from a customer
Add tracing so I can follow a request across services
Define SLOs and decide what should page someone
Write the postmortem for last night's incident
Will we survive launch-day traffic? How much headroom do we have?
Are we ready to go live? Check backups, alerts, rollback and limits
What happens if our region, database or main vendor goes down?
Set up a status page and an on-call rota for a tiny team
